item.tib: dbal chen 'brug gsas chem pa tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrab pa chen po'i bsnyen sgrab las sbyor gyi sgrab khog mngon du phyung ba yang gsang bla med me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi snying po bton pa grub pa yongs kyi mgul rgyan
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang dbal chen gsang ba 'dus pa snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron mer bsam bzhin srid pa nye bar bzung ba/ 7 rje nyer gsum pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ mchog chen po rig 'dzin kun grol grags pa'i skye ba bzhi pa bstan 'dzin tshul khrims grags pa/ sdong sgom chen po bstan pa lhun grub dang a mdo tshe dbang rin po che rnams kyi yang srid sogs g.yung drung bon gyi gdan sa chen po rnam gsum gyi skyes chen khyad par 'phags pa rnams dang*/ khyad par ku sa zla ba 'od zer gyi yang sprul mi shig g.yung drung 'byung gnas rtsal lam 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po nas kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang dngos po rgyu yi gnang skyel gya nom pas mtshon te bka' dgongs phur gsum khro phur zhang gsum sogs g.yung drung bon gyi gsang sngags snying por gyur pa 'di rnams la/ bsgrub chen bshad tshom dang bcas pa re byung na 'byung 'gyur g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa la phan thog rgya cher 'byung ba'i lung dang bka' nan gyi dus lan gcig tsam ma yin par yang dang yang du bsngags pa sogs 'gran zla dang bral ba rnams kyi bstan rnying gso zhing gter gsar spel ba'i bstan pa spyi la gcig tu dgongs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang 'brel ba'i lha rdzas ring mo gya nom gyis mtshams sbyar yang nas yang du ched bskul gnang ba blo la bcag nye bar skam bla ma tshe dbang bstan rgyal dang / nyi dbang grags pa'i dpal/ tshe dbang rgyal mtshan sogs smin cing mos pa'i skal pa can mang po'i (pos) ched du bskul ba la/ la chen gshen po lnga yi zhabs pad spyi bor bkod pa/ g.yung drung bdud 'dul thogs med rtsal gyis snga srol gyer spungs chen po'i zhal rgyun gsar rnying dang mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyi srol la legs par gzhigs shing 'grigs shing 'grigs chags su bsgrigs te sgrub pa chen po phyag tu bzhes thabs 'di yang / sprul pa'i gnas chen brgyad kyi ya gyal/ rig bzhi'i nang tshan bam brag brtsegasaM pa rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil/ mtsho steng bde ldan gsang sngags khrod kyi 'chi med g.yu 'brang bkod pa'i khang bzang du chu rta sgron zla'i/ snga ma'i phyogs bzang po gnyis par grub par bgyis shing / yi ge'i byed po dad rtse dwangs pa'i rnam dpyod yangs pa'i dpal gyur sprul sku nyi ma'i dbang po dang / tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gnyis nas brtson cing 'grus pas bsam pa dag la sbyor ba gus pas sgrub pa'i dge tshogs bstan pa'i dpal du 'bar bar gyur cig/
